observation.visible_scene: Extreme close-up of a white, translucent, lumpy and porous mass (with a few small dark holes/spots near its upper-right) set against a pale yellow surface and a dark band along the top edge. A slender dark tool/rod enters the frame from the right and interacts with the mass.
visible_changes: Frames 1-6: the white mass is largely static; only a faint dark speck at upper right is visible, no tool yet in frame.
Frames 7-10: a dark, thin, elongated tool/rod enters from the right edge and moves leftward toward the upper-right portion of the white mass.
Frames 11-16: the tool tip presses into the mass; a small strand/blob of the white material hangs from the tool near the contact point.
Frames 17-30: the tool lies more horizontally across the middle-right of the mass; a bluish-tinted gap/region appears just behind and below the tool as the white material deforms around it.
Frames 31-41: the tool drifts downward and rightward, ending near the lower-right; the white mass's left cavity edge and overall shape shift within the frame.
Throughout, the framing of the mass and background changes slightly (apparent camera pan/tilt/zoom), so absolute positions are partly camera-driven.
outside_clip_unknowns: Identity of the white material and of the dark tool; what caused the tool to approach; what happens after the segment ends; whether the bluish region is a separate surface, a gap, or a reflection.
uncertain_details: Cannot fully separate tool motion from camera motion; the apparent leftward/downward drift of the tool may include camera movement.
Whether the tool is cutting, prying, or merely resting against the mass is not determinable.
The bluish area could be a revealed gap, a different material, or a color shift from lighting; not confirmed.
The hanging white blob on the tool may be a drip, a strand, or adhered fragment.
